correctness.rationale: Lagrange multipliers and Euler homogeneity yield a nonzero eigenray for the top homogeneous gradient. The exact scalar homogeneous solution has all nonzero Taylor coefficients; induction identifies the top degree of the full Lie iterates and prevents cancellation. Thus degrees 1+k(d-2) are exact. A finite linear polynomial lift would bound all Lie iterates to a finite polynomial span. The degree-at-most-two affine converse is immediate. The standalone exact rational checker passed all 80 declared finite checks; those are not substitutes for the all-k proof.

value.rationale: The natural existence question for exactly state-retaining polynomial Koopman dictionaries receives a full sharp boundary across all real polynomial gradient potentials, with an explicit degree cost for each finite Lie-jet order. It applies even to strongly convex quartics with a unique equilibrium, beyond known topological fixed-point obstructions, and distinguishes exact closures from approximate dictionary constructions.
